t.zh: 一行像素之间，新像素按左右两个邻居加权。放大一张二维的图，新像素在上下方向也落在两行之间：它周围有四个旧像素。
t.en: Within a row, a new pixel weighs its left and right neighbours. Enlarging a 2D image, a new pixel also falls between two rows: there are four old pixels around it.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：落在四个旧像素围成的方格里的新像素，值怎么算？先在格子上手算一张 2 × 2 的图放大成 3 × 3，再接一块电路：输入一张图和新的宽、高，交出缩放后的图，二维放大和缩小的测试都对才算对。
t.en: This level asks: how is a new pixel inside the square of four old ones worked out? First work a 2 × 2 image enlarged to 3 × 3 by hand on the grid, then wire a circuit: given an image and a new width and height, give the resized image, right when the tests of enlarging and shrinking in two dimensions all are.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：上下两行各沿 x 插值，再沿 y 插一次，得到四个邻居的加权平均，比最近邻平滑。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: along x on the rows above and below, then along y, a weighted average of the four neighbours, smoother than nearest neighbour.

brief.zh: 这张 2 × 2 的图放大成 3 × 3：新像素的 x、y 都落在 −1/6、0.5、7/6。写出 3 × 3 的值；落在外面的取最近的边。
brief.en: This 2 × 2 image is enlarged to 3 × 3: the new pixels' x and y both fall at −1/6, 0.5 and 7/6. Write the 3 × 3 values; positions outside take the nearest edge.

hint.zh: 中间那一行落在 y = 0.5，正好在两行中间：它该等于哪一行？
hint.en: The middle row falls at y = 0.5, right between the two rows: which row should it equal?

hint.zh: 先把上下两行各自横着放大，再在两行之间竖着取。
hint.en: Enlarge the top and bottom rows across first, then take between the two rows downwards.

why.zh: 只横着插了一次，竖直方向照抄最近的一行：中间一行落在两行正中，却整个抄了下面那一行。竖着也按距离加权，中心是四个邻居的平均 6。
why.en: That interpolates across only and copies the nearest row downwards: the middle row, right between the two, copies the lower one whole. Weighted by distance downwards too, the centre is the four neighbours' average, 6.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，每个新像素由周围四个旧像素按距离加权。
brief.en: Given an image and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel weighted from the four old pixels around it by distance.

hint.zh: 竖直方向也有一个距离：新位置离上面那一行有多远。
hint.en: There is a vertical distance too: how far the new position is from the row above.

hint.zh: 上下两行各沿 x 插一次，得到两个值，再在它们之间沿 y 插一次。
hint.en: Interpolate along x on the row above and on the row below, then along y between the two results.
